products.name: macOS Enrollment, SSO & FileVault Troubleshooting & Diagnostics Toolkit — Commercial
products.short_description: A structured root-cause tree and diagnostic scripts for macOS + Intune failures — ADE/enrollment, SSO login, SecureToken/FileVault, compliance/CA, post-enrollment lock-outs — isolate the failing layer fast. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Fix the Mac enrollment, SSO and FileVault failures — fast

When a Mac won't enroll, Platform/Extensible SSO won't sign in, or FileVault/SecureToken blocks a user, the cause hides across the Apple profile, the Intune policy, and the Entra identity. This toolkit gives you a structured root-cause tree and diagnostic scripts for the macOS + Intune stack — ADE/enrollment, SSO login, SecureToken/FileVault, compliance/CA, and post-enrollment lock-outs — so you isolate the failing layer in minutes.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the macOS-Intune signal path (ADE/enrollment → profiles → SSO → SecureToken/FileVault → compliance/CA) and the layered model behind the root-cause tree.
  • Requirements Guide — what you need to diagnose (Intune + Graph read access, device logs, the Apple/SSO vantage points) with how to verify each.
  • Diagnostic Playbook — a symptom tree (ADE not assigned / enrollment stuck, SSO won't sign in, SecureToken/FileVault error, compliant-but-denied, user locked after enrollment) with exact checks per branch.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — enrollment/profile discovery, per-device SSO + SecureToken/FileVault validation, a consolidated diagnostics report, safe re-sync/remediation, and a target-group builder (read-only where it matters).
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides mapping each gate to the fix, plus Best Practices for evidence-based escalation.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

The failing layer of a stuck Mac isolated in minutes — enrollment, SSO, SecureToken/FileVault, or compliance — with a repeatable playbook and scripts you keep and reuse.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • MACDX-Discovery.ps1 — read-only inventory of macOS managed devices and their enrollment/health context
    • MACDX-Remediation.ps1 — safe device Sync to re-pull policy on a macOS device (defaults to WhatIf)
    • MACDX-Report.ps1 — read-only fleet-health and FileVault escrow-coverage summary for macOS + Intune
    • MACDX-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — build/adjust pilot target groups for macOS devices (defaults to WhatIf)
    • MACDX-Validation.ps1 — read-only per-device, per-layer state check for a macOS + Intune failure

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
